_about: Key bindings for the To the Dragon Cave PC port. This file is saved next to the program. Edit the lists and restart the game. Combine modifiers like CTRL+SPACE.

_gestures.attack: Original gesture: swipe up with one finger - attack with the current weapon
_gestures.crouch: Original gesture: swipe down with one finger - crouch (levels 12, 21, 24)
_gestures.crossbow: Original gesture: swipe left with two fingers - draw the crossbow
_gestures.sword: Original gesture: swipe right with two fingers - draw the sword
_gestures.potion: Original gesture: swipe up with two fingers - drink a healing potion
_gestures.fireball: Original gesture: shake the phone - throw a fireball
_gestures.turn_left: Original gesture: drag one finger to the left - turn left
_gestures.turn_right: Original gesture: drag one finger to the right - turn right
_gestures.confirm: Original gesture: tap - confirm / select in menus
_gestures.back: Original gesture: system back - leave the current menu
_gestures.status: Original gesture: double tap - read health, arrows, gold
